upstream_source_evidence.claim: Functional quantifiers are parsed and normalized but not evaluated.
Recurrence fixpoint enumeration has a 500-step limit that is not a nonexistence proof.
The public API is unstable and requires external serialization for concurrent use.
Minterm enumeration has exponential worst case and no deadline or tri-state result.
An eventual-flag search can return F after a bounded failure that is not an unsatisfiability proof.
The parser test build can fetch doctest from an unpinned master branch.

observed_capabilities.finding: Small sbf conjunctions and exclusive state-machine guards execute within the retained 30 second budget.
The pinned binary executed direct bv[8] and bv[256] stream addition; the previous embedded binary failed to create the output for the same bv[8] stream-addition probe.
bv[256] addition wraps modulo 2^256; max plus one produced zero.
Pointwise revision is implemented, while immediate outputs after an update can remain unspecified when the new rule has lookback.
fall and fex are parsed and retained as atomic terms; upstream documentation says they are not evaluated.

practical_limits.finding: A two-step bv[256] stream-addition probe with an explicit non-wrap comparison exceeded 30 seconds.
practical_limits.consequence: Keep full-width accounting transitions and overflow enforcement in Rust or a separately proved arithmetic layer.

practical_limits.finding: The 22-input perp risk envelope exceeded 30 seconds in the 64-step campaign and exceeded 60 seconds in a one-step probe.
practical_limits.consequence: Use Tau for compact admission facts or cached proof qualification around the perps kernel.

practical_limits.finding: Upstream fixpoint and eventual-flag searches have 500-step caps; one path explicitly returns F after a bounded failure that is not a proof of unsatisfiability.
practical_limits.consequence: Treat Tau Error, timeout, bounded-failure diagnostics, and unknown outcomes as fail-closed indeterminate results.

practical_limits.finding: The solver documents a worst-case 2^vars minterm enumeration with no budget or tri-state result contract.
practical_limits.consequence: Every admitted Tau profile needs a resource envelope and exact-version qualification.

practical_limits.finding: The public API is documented as highly unstable and single-threaded unless the caller serializes access.
practical_limits.consequence: Use process isolation or an externally serialized adapter and bind its exact binary identity.

practical_limits.finding: The build can fetch doctest from master and uses dependency tags for unordered_dense and FTXUI; dependency authenticity remains outside this receipt.
practical_limits.consequence: A promotable Tau toolchain requires a closed source manifest or reproducible hermetic build.

practical_limits.finding: Existing per-spec profile markers retain historical Tau 401d756b observations and do not qualify those specs under c43c66b8.
practical_limits.consequence: Requalify each runtime-admitted relation against one exact Tau profile before changing any admission status.

contracts: A public TauIntegrationProfileV1 is canonical source and semantics data and grants no runtime authority.

A module-controlled TauIntegrationProfileReceiptV1 binds the exact promotion subject, current state, deployment configuration, authority epoch, profile, governance, rule history, capabilities, refinement root, and verifier profile.
Negative observations remain valid evidence with profile_usable false; a purported verified-compatible observation with any incomplete or crossed fact rejects.
Operation disposition derives profile usability exclusively from the verified receipt and contains no caller-authored usability Boolean.
The verifier-owned disposition context binds the expected operation root and rejects crossed operation evidence.
A valid reject-or-pend decision has authorizes_execution false.
TauWriterProfileBindingV1 binds a usable receipt to one exact writer target but is not a J07 writer token or commit capability.
The V2 Tau eligibility refinement consumes the exact Tau writer-profile binding, one independently verified policy context, and one exact post-switch J07 authority context.

The V3 J07 token binds the Tau-derived eligibility receipt to the admission context, promotion subject, source schema, policy, verifier profile, writer profile, authority epoch, state, head, snapshot, and migration token.
The admission and token registries each reject above 8192 live values and reclaim mutation snapshots when registered values become unreachable.
Profile and disposition projections agree with the exact pinned Tau relations for the retained bounded vectors.
authority_limits: The external verifier adapter is a shell premise and no authoritative verifier selection is mounted.
Python module construction provenance is not cryptographic authenticity.
No strict untrusted-wire decoder is provided for this profile value.
The Tau-to-J07 writer-authority relation is unmounted and carries no publication or datastore capability.
The integration module remains a large bounded trust-boundary surface that should be split before mounting.

nonclaims: No Tau integration profile is mounted.
